Full ownership: Owning the complete infrastructure of a company that moves clinical trial data for dozens of customers. Fixing things for good: Working through a real backlog and removing root causes so the same problems stop coming back. AI-native operations: Directing AI agents to do infrastructure work is already how you operate, and you want an environment that pushes it further. Improving a live system: Making an existing platform cheaper, faster, and more reliable step by step, rather than rebuilding it from scratch. Defining a function: Shaping what infrastructure at Rivia becomes as the company grows.

Own our AWS platform end to end across staging and production: EKS, RDS, MemoryDB/Redis, S3, DynamoDB, IAM, networking. Production Kubernetes operations experience. A proper software engineer: you write production-quality code and can diagnose and fix problems inside application codebases when needed (JVM experience a plus).
